---
title: "Olympic Winners from 1900 - 2018:"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

olympics <- read_csv("athlete_events.csv")
olympicsF <- olympics |> filter (Sex == "F")
olympicsM <- olympics |> filter (Sex == "M")
```

```{r}
particpation <- olympics |> group_by(Games, Sex) |> mutate(n_Participants = n()) |> slice(1)

particpation <- particpation |> mutate(Year = as.factor(Year))

particpation <- particpation |> mutate(Year = fct_inseq(Year))

ggplot(particpation, aes(x = Year, y = n_Participants)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Sex)) +
  facet_wrap(~Season)
```
